n-m-e1-s2b-03.title: Ƙirga beads na zare bisa launi
n-m-e1-s2b-03.goal: Idan zare mai tsarin launi mai maimaituwa ya ƙare a tsakiyar saiti, a koyi cewa dole ne a ƙirga beads da suka rage a ƙarshen bisa launinsu ma, sannan a duba yadda adadin kowane launi ke canzawa da yawan beads.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.material: Minho ya zura beads 8 kamar haka: ja, shuɗi, shuɗi, ja, shuɗi, shuɗi, ja, shuɗi. Minho yana son sanin adadin beads ja da shuɗi. Ga mafitar Minho a ƙasa.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.thinking.0: Nemo kuma ka gyara layin da ba daidai ba a mafita
n-m-e1-s2b-03.thinking.1: Ƙirga ɓangaren da ya rage a ƙarshen dabam
n-m-e1-s2b-03.thinking.2: Nemo lambobi daban-daban da yawa da suka cika sharadi
n-m-e1-s2b-03.prereq.0: Karanta zaren beads mai tsarin ja, shuɗi
n-m-e1-s2b-03.prereq.1: Ƙirga da tara lambobi har zuwa 10
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda ɗaya kawai a mafitar Minho da ya fara yin kuskure.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s1.hint.0: Zana beads 8, ka ƙirga beads ja da shuɗi dabam-dabam.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ko tara adadin ja da shuɗi da Minho ya faɗa yana ba da adadi iri ɗaya da beads 8.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s1.line.0: Zaren beads yana maimaita “ja, shuɗi, shuɗi”.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s1.line.1: Idan aka ɗauki “ja, shuɗi, shuɗi” a matsayin saiti guda, beads 8 suna da saiti biyu da ƙarin beads 2.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s1.line.2: Saiti guda yana da ja 1 da shuɗi 2, don haka saiti biyu suna da ja 2 da shuɗi 4.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s1.line.3: Beads 2 da suka rage ba sa cikakken saiti, saboda haka ba a ƙirga su. Jimilla ja 2 da shuɗi 4 ne.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s1.explain: Layi na 4 ne na farko da ba daidai ba. Beads 2 da suka rage a ƙarshen zaren beads ne ma, dole ne a ƙirga su bisa launi. Beads 2 da suka rage ja da shuɗi ne, saboda haka ja 2+1=3, shuɗi kuma 4+1=5. Layuka na 1 zuwa 3 daidai ne.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s2.prompt: Idan aka zura beads 10 da wannan tsarin, beads shuɗi nawa ne za a samu?
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s2.hint.0: Zana beads 10 a jere, ka rubuta launukansu.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s2.hint.1: Idan beads sun rage a ƙarshen zaren, yi amfani da tsarin don sanin launinsu.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s2.r.b: Duba ko ka ƙirga beads ja. Ƙirga beads 10 bisa launinsu.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s2.r.c: Wannan tunanin ya ɗauka cewa rabin beads ne. Duba ko adadin shuɗi da ja iri ɗaya ne.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s2.r.d: Wannan tunanin ya ƙirga bead ɗin da ya rage a ƙarshen zaren a matsayin shuɗi. Yi amfani da tsarin don duba launin bead ɗin da ya rage.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s2.explain: Idan saiti ja, shuɗi, shuɗi ya maimaitu sau 3, beads 9 ne, bead na 10 kuma ja ne. Ja 3+1=4, shuɗi 6.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s3.prompt: Zura beads da tsarin iri ɗaya, fara da ja. Nemo adadin beads n daban-daban guda uku inda beads shuɗi suka zama daidai sau 2 na ja. (Beads aƙalla 7 ne kuma ba su wuce 20 ba.)
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s3.hint.0: Canza adadin beads zuwa 7, 8, 9, ... ka rubuta a tebur adadin ja da shuɗi a kowane lokaci.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s3.hint.1: Tara adadin beads inda shuɗi sau 2 na ja ne, ka duba abin da suka yi tarayya.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s3.ok.c1: Akwai beads aƙalla 7 kuma ba su wuce 20 ba.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s3.fail.c1: Zaɓi adadin beads lamba ta halitta daga 7 zuwa 20.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s3.ok.c2: Beads shuɗi daidai sau 2 ne na beads ja.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s3.fail.c2: Tare da wannan adadin beads, shuɗi ba sau 2 na ja ba ne. Zana beads, ka ƙirga su bisa launi.
n-m-e1-s2b-03.s.s3.explain: Idan beads sun kai 9, 12, 15, ko 18, zaren yana ƙarewa daidai bayan saitin “ja, shuɗi, shuɗi”, don haka shuɗi sau 2 ne na ja. Idan beads suka rage bayan saitin, akwai ja ɗaya ko shuɗi ɗaya ƙari, saboda haka ba sau 2 ba ne.

n-m-e1-s2b-04.title: Kukis nawa ka iya ragewa?
n-m-e1-s2b-04.goal: A cikin labarin ragi, bi yadda zangon ƙimomin da za su iya zama adadin abin da ya rage ke ƙuntatawa duk lokacin da aka ba da ƙarin bayani, sannan nemo iyakar inda adadi biyun suka yi daidai.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.material: Akwai kukis a faranti. Idan aka ci kukis, adadin da ya rage a farantin yana canzawa. Kana son sanin yawan kukis da suka rage bayan Minji ta ci. Ana ba da ƙarin bayani ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.thinking.0: Faɗi abin da ba ka sani ba tukuna a matsayin zangon ƙimomi
n-m-e1-s2b-04.thinking.1: Ƙuntata yuwuwar adadi da sabon bayani
n-m-e1-s2b-04.thinking.2: Nemo iyakar inda suka yi daidai
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.prompt: Duk lokacin da aka ba ka sabon bayani, zaɓi abin da za ka iya faɗa game da kukis da suka rage.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.hint.0: Nuna yawan kukis na farko da adadin da aka ci a labarin da hoto ko kalmomi.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ƙara sabon bayani a labarin, ka kwatanta ko ra’ayin da ka zaɓa a baya har yanzu daidai ne.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Akwai kukis 6 a faranti. Minji ta ci wasu kukis. Ba ka san tukuna nawa ta ci ba.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kukis nawa ne suka rage a faranti?
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Idan ba ka san adadin da aka ci ba, ba za ka iya tantance adadin da ya rage a matsayin lamba guda ba. Amma za ka iya sanin cewa ya kasa 6.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Minji ta ci, saboda haka kukis sun ragu. Ba za su iya zama 6 kamar da ba.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ban san adadin ba, amma kukis ƙasa da 6 ne suka rage.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Idan an ci kukis, adadin da ya rage zai ragu ne kawai. Ba zai fi na farko yawa ba.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wannan tunanin ya ɗauka cewa an ci guda 1 kawai. Ba ka san tukuna nawa aka ci ba.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Ya nuna cewa kukis da suka rage sun fi waɗanda aka ci. Har yanzu ba ka san yawan da aka ci ba.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Idan an ci kuki 1, 5 ne suka rage; idan an ci 2, 4 ne suka rage, don haka waɗanda suka rage sun fi waɗanda aka ci. Idan an ci 3, su ma 3 ne suka rage, daidai suke. Don haka kukis 4 ko 5 ne za su iya ragewa.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Idan kukis 3 ne suka rage, an ci kukis 3 ma; saboda haka waɗanda suka rage ba su fi waɗanda aka ci ba.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Idan kuki 1 ya rage, an ci kukis 5. Duba ko waɗanda suka rage sun fi waɗanda aka ci.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan tunanin bai yi amfani da sabon bayanin da aka bayar ba.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.st.2.info: An ce Minji ta ci kukis 2.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kukis nawa ne suka rage? Haka kuma duba ko ya dace da abin da ka gano a baya.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Idan aka cire 2 daga 6, 4 ne suka rage. 4 yana cikin “4 ko 5” da aka samu a baya, don haka bayanan sun yi daidai.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Duba ko ka gauraya shi da yanayin da aka ci 3.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Idan 5 ne suka rage, an ci kuki 1.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wannan tunanin ya ƙara 2 ga 6. Idan an ci kukis, adadin yana raguwa.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s1.reflect: Da farko ka san cewa kukis ƙasa da 6 ne suka rage kawai. Yayin da aka ƙara kowane sabon bayani, yuwuwar adadin ta ƙuntata zuwa 4 ko 5; da zarar an san adadin da aka ci, ya zama lamba guda. Bayyana yadda tunaninka ya ƙuntata da kowane sabon bayani.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s2.prompt: A wannan karon akwai kukis 10 a faranti. Minji ta ci aƙalla 1, kuma kukis da suka rage sun fi waɗanda aka ci. Zaɓi yawan kukis da aka ci a da waɗanda suka rage b ta hanyoyi daban-daban guda uku.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s2.hint.0: Yanke shawarar adadin kukis da aka ci, sannan ka nemo nawa suka rage idan an cire adadin daga 10.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s2.hint.1: Sanya adadin da ya rage da wanda aka ci kusa da juna, ka kwatanta wanne ya fi yawa.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s2.var.a: Adadin kukis da aka ci a
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s2.var.b: Adadin kukis da suka rage b
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Ka sanya a matsayin lamba ta halitta aƙalla 1 ga kukis da aka ci, kuma aƙalla 0 ga waɗanda suka rage.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Jimillar kukis da aka ci da waɗanda suka rage ita ce 10.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Dole ne kukis da aka ci da waɗanda suka rage su haɗu su zama kukis 10 na farko.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Kukis da suka rage sun fi waɗanda aka ci.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Kukis da suka rage ba su fi waɗanda aka ci ba.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s2.explain: Idan aka ci kukis 1, 2, 3, ko 4, sai 9, 8, 7, ko 6 su rage, don haka waɗanda suka rage sun fi yawa. Idan aka ci 5, 5 ne ma suka rage, saboda haka ba su fi yawa ba.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s3.prompt: Cikin kukis 10, nawa ne ya kamata a ci don waɗanda suka rage su fi waɗanda aka ci? (An ci aƙalla kuki 1.)
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s3.hint.0: Ƙara adadin kukis da aka ci ɗaya bayan ɗaya daga 1, ka rubuta a tebur yadda adadin da ya rage ke canzawa.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s3.hint.1: Nemo lokacin da kukis da suka rage da waɗanda aka ci suka yi daidai.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s3.r.a: Idan aka ci kukis 5, 5 ne kuma suka rage, saboda haka adadin ya yi daidai.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s3.r.b: Idan an ƙara yawan kukis da aka ci, ƙananan ne za su rage. Duba nawa suka rage idan an ci 6.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s3.o.c: Abin da ake buƙata shi ne ya kasa 10 kawai.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s3.r.c: Idan an ci 9, kuki 1 ne kawai ya rage.
n-m-e1-s2b-04.s.s3.explain: Idan aka ci 1, 2, 3, ko 4, waɗanda suka rage sun fi yawa; idan 5, daidai suke; idan 6 ko fiye, waɗanda suka rage sun fi kaɗan. Saboda haka dole ne a ci ƙasa da 5. Iyakar ita ce 5, wadda ke raba 10 gida biyu daidai.

n-m-e1-s2-01.title: Nemo lambobin da za su iya shiga cikin akwatin lamba
n-m-e1-s2-01.topic: Lambobin da ba 100 ba: jere da kwatanta girma (fiye da, ƙasa da)
n-m-e1-s2-01.goal: Zaɓi lambobin da suka cika sharadin “fiye da ... kuma ƙasa da ...”, ƙirƙiri wasu da kanka, sannan ka ƙirga adadinsu gaba ɗaya bisa jeren lambobi.
n-m-e1-s2-01.material: Muna wasan akwatin lambobi. Alamar gaban akwatin ta ce “Saka lambobin da suka fi 70 kuma suka kasa 80 kawai.” Za ka gwada saka katunan lambobi cikin akwatin ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
n-m-e1-s2-01.thinking.0: Duba ma’anar sharadi (fiye da, ƙasa da) ɗaya bayan ɗaya
n-m-e1-s2-01.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri misalan da suka cika sharadin, sannan ka duba su
n-m-e1-s2-01.thinking.2: Ƙirga ba tare da rasa ko ƙara wani ba
n-m-e1-s2-01.prereq.0: Karanta lambobi har zuwa 100 kuma ka ƙirga su a jere (matakin aji na 1)
n-m-e1-s2-01.prereq.1: Faɗin wanne daga lambobi biyu ya fi ko ya ƙasa
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk katunan lambobi da za a iya saka cikin akwatin.
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ga kowane kati, tambayi dabam: “Ya fi 70?” da “Ya kasa 80?”
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s1.r.a: An saka wannan ba tare da duba ko 70 ya fi 70 ba.
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s1.r.b: 71 ya fi 70 kuma ya kasa 80. Rubuta lambobin a jere ka duba.
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s1.r.c: 79 ya fi 70 kuma ya kasa 80. Rubuta lambobin a jere ka duba.
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s1.r.d: An saka wannan ba tare da duba ko 80 ya kasa 80 ba.
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s1.explain: 70 daidai yake da 70, don haka bai fi 70 ba; 80 kuma daidai yake da 80, don haka bai kasa 80 ba. 71 da 79 sun cika sharuddan biyu.
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri katunan lambobi daban-daban guda uku da za a saka cikin akwatin. A wannan karon, zaɓi lambobin da lambarsu ta ɗaya ta fi 5 kawai.
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta duk lambobin da suka fi 70 kuma suka kasa 80 a jere.
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s2.hint.1: Cikin su, yi wa lambobin da lambarsu ta ɗaya ta fi 5 alama.
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Bai fi 70 ba kuma bai kasa 80 ba. Rubuta lambobin a jere ka tambayi ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko sun cika sharadin.
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Lambarsa ta ɗaya ba ta fi 5 ba.
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s2.explain: 76, 77, 78, da 79 duk daidai ne. 70 da 80 suna da 0 a wurin ɗaya, don haka lambarsu ta ɗaya ba ta fi 5 ba, kuma ba su cika “fiye da 70” ko “ƙasa da 80” ba.
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s3.prompt: A wannan karon babu sharadi game da wurin ɗaya. Lambobi nawa ne gaba ɗaya suka fi 70 kuma suka kasa 80?
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s3.hint.0: Bar 70 da 80, sannan ka rubuta lambobin da ke tsakaninsu ɗaya bayan ɗaya a jere.
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s3.hint.1: Nuna kowace lambar da ka rubuta, ka ƙirga su.
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s3.r.a: Wannan ya ƙirga lamba ɗaya fiye daga 70 da 80.
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s3.r.b: Wannan ya ƙirga duk lambobin daga 70 zuwa 80, har da ƙarshen biyun.
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s3.r.c: Wannan ya ƙirga ta hanyar rubuta lambobin da suka cika sharadin a jere.
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s3.r.d: Wannan ya cire ƙarshen biyun, sannan ya sake cire ɗaya.
n-m-e1-s2-01.s.s3.explain: Lambobi 9 ne: 71, 72, 73, 74, 75, 76, 77, 78, 79. 10 da aka samu daga 80−70 tazarar ƙarshen biyun ce, ta bambanta da adadin lambobin da ke tsakaninsu.

n-m-e1-s2b-02.title: Bayan katuna nawa ne katunan hotuna za su yi kama da juna?
n-m-e1-s2b-02.goal: A ƙa'idar da abubuwa biyu suke sauyawa tare, kamar siffa da launi, ka gwada da jera katuna domin tabbatar da cewa maimaituwar abu ɗaya ba yana nufin katin gaba ɗaya yana maimaituwa ba.
n-m-e1-s2b-02.material: Jiho yana jera katunan hotuna a layi. Siffofin suna canzawa tsakanin ○ da □, launuka kuma suna zagayawa ja, shuɗi, rawaya a jere. Na 1 ja ○ ne, na 2 shuɗi □ ne, na 3 kuma rawaya ○ ne. Jiho ya ce, “Launuka suna maimaituwa duk katuna 3, saboda haka katin iri ɗaya zai sake zuwa duk katuna 3.”
n-m-e1-s2b-02.thinking.0: Duba da'awar da ta kalli siffa ɗaya kawai amma ta yi magana game da duka
n-m-e1-s2b-02.thinking.1: Nemo misalin da ya karyata da'awar ta hanyar jera katunan da kanka
n-m-e1-s2b-02.thinking.2: Ka kwatanta tsawon lokacin da ƙa'idodin biyun suke ɗauka kafin su sake dawowa
n-m-e1-s2b-02.prereq.0: Karanta tsarin launi da tsarin siffa dabam-dabam.
n-m-e1-s2b-02.prereq.1: Sanin kalmomin jerantawa (nawa: na farko, na biyu, ...)
n-m-e1-s2b-02.s.s1.prompt: Me kake tunani game da abin da Jiho ya faɗa? Zana kati na 4 bisa ƙa’idojin, sannan ka yanke shawara.
n-m-e1-s2b-02.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko rubuta launukan katunan 1 zuwa 4 kawai, sannan ka rubuta siffofin kawai dabam.
n-m-e1-s2b-02.s.s1.hint.1: Sanya kati na 4 kusa da kati na 1, ka kwatanta launi da siffa ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
n-m-e1-s2b-02.s.s1.o.a: Daidai ne. Kati na 4 ma zai zama ○ ja.
n-m-e1-s2b-02.s.s1.r.a: Tuna ko ka tantance launi da siffar kati na 4 dabam-dabam. Siffar tana canzawa bayan kowane kati biyu.
n-m-e1-s2b-02.s.s1.o.b: Ba daidai ba. Kati na 4 ja ne, amma siffarsa □ ce.
n-m-e1-s2b-02.s.s1.o.c: Ba daidai ba. Tun farko ka fahimci yadda launuka ke zagayawa ba daidai ba.
n-m-e1-s2b-02.s.s1.r.c: Tsarin launi daidai yake da wanda matsalar ta faɗa. Ka duba dalilin da ka ce ba daidai ba ta amfani da kati na 4.
n-m-e1-s2b-02.s.s1.o.d: Ba zan iya sani ba. Sai an jera ƙarin katuna.
n-m-e1-s2b-02.s.s1.r.d: An riga an ƙayyade ƙa’idojin, saboda haka za ka iya sanin kati na 4. Ci gaba da launuka da siffofi bi da bi.
n-m-e1-s2b-02.s.s1.explain: Launin kati na 4 ya koma ja, amma siffofin suna musanyawa ○, □, ○, □, don haka siffarsa □ ce. Kati na 4 ba iri ɗaya da na 1 ba ne. Abu guda ɗaya da ya yi daidai ba ya sa dukan katin ya zama iri ɗaya.
n-m-e1-s2b-02.s.s2.prompt: A lamba nawa ne kati da launinsa da siffofinsa duk iri ɗaya da na kati na 1 zai fara bayyana?
n-m-e1-s2b-02.s.s2.hint.0: Zana katunan har zuwa na 7. A ƙarƙashin kowace lamba, rubuta launi da siffa tare.
n-m-e1-s2b-02.s.s2.hint.1: Yi wa katunan da launinsu da siffofinsu duk iri ɗaya da na kati na 1 alama.
n-m-e1-s2b-02.s.s2.r.a: Kati na 3 rawaya ne. Duba ko launin ya bambanta.
n-m-e1-s2b-02.s.s2.r.b: Kati na 4 yana da siffa dabam. Tuna abin da ka duba a baya.
n-m-e1-s2b-02.s.s2.r.c: Kwatanta launi da siffar kati na 6 da na kati na 1.
n-m-e1-s2b-02.s.s2.explain: Idan aka jera katunan a jere, su ne ○ ja, □ shuɗi, ○ rawaya, □ ja, ○ shuɗi, □ rawaya, ○ ja. Kati na 7 ne karo na farko da ya yi daidai da kati na 1 gabaki ɗaya. Launukan suna dawowa bayan katuna 3, siffofi kuma bayan 2, don su dawo tare duka ana buƙatar katuna 6.

n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s1.hint.1: Yi alama iri ɗaya ga siffofi iri ɗaya a kowane layi, sannan ka kwatanta ko wuraren su ne daidai da na layin Seoa.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s1.r.a: Akwai nau'ikan siffofi guda 3, kuma tsarin yana maimaituwa duk katuna 3. Layin Seoa yana da nau'ikan siffofi guda 2.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s1.r.c: Siffofi iri ɗaya suna zuwa bibbiyu. Ka kwatanta da wuraren da siffofi iri ɗaya suke a layin Seoa.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s1.r.e: Siffofi biyu suna canzawa ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A layin Seoa akwai wuraren da siffa ɗaya take zuwa sau biyu a jere.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s1.explain: Layin Seoa yana maimaita “siffa ɗaya sai siffofi biyu iri ɗaya a jere”. △ □ □ △ □ □ da □ ○ ○ □ ○ ○ ma suna da wannan tsari. Ko da nau'ikan siffofin sun bambanta, ƙa'idar iri ɗaya ce idan siffofi iri ɗaya suna wurare iri ɗaya.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s2.prompt: Ka ɗauki ○ a matsayin 1, □ a matsayin 2, △ kuma a matsayin 3. Ƙirƙiri layuka masu ƙa'ida iri ɗaya da ta Seoa. Rubuta kati na farko da a, na biyu da b, na uku da c, na huɗu kuma da d. Ƙirƙiri layuka daban-daban guda 3.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s2.hint.0: A layin Seoa ○ □ □ ○, da farko nemo wuraren da katuna iri ɗaya suke.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi siffofi biyu, ka jera su yadda siffofi iri ɗaya za su kasance wurare iri ɗaya da layin Seoa. Sanya layin da ka gama a kan layin Seoa ka kwatanta.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Ka yi amfani da 1, 2, ko 3 a katunan.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Za ka iya amfani da 1, 2, ko 3 kawai a katunan.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Katuna na farko da na biyu sun bambanta.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s2.fail.c2: A layin Seoa, katuna na farko da na biyu sun bambanta.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Katuna na biyu da na uku iri ɗaya ne.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s2.fail.c3: A layin Seoa, katuna na biyu da na uku iri ɗaya ne. Ka kwatanta da layin Seoa.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s2.ok.c4: Kati na huɗu iri ɗaya ne da na farko, saboda haka ƙa'idar ta sake farawa.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s2.fail.c4: Sake duba katin da kati na huɗu yake daidai da shi a layin Seoa.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s2.explain: Idan kati na farko da na biyu sun bambanta, na biyu da na uku iri ɗaya ne, na huɗu kuma iri ɗaya ne da na farko, kamar ○ □ □ ○, △ ○ ○ △, da □ △ △ □, to ƙa'idar iri ɗaya ce da ta layin Seoa. Jimilla za ka iya ƙirƙirar layuka 6 ta hanyar musanya siffofin.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s3.prompt: “○ □ □ ○ □ □” da “△ ○ ○ △ ○ ○” sun yi amfani da siffofi dabam. Duk da haka, me ya sa za mu ce suna da ƙa'ida iri ɗaya?
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s3.hint.0: Sanya layukan biyu ɗaya saman ɗaya, sannan ka zana layukan haɗi tsakanin siffofi iri ɗaya.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ka kwatanta ko layukan haɗin suna farawa da ƙarewa a wurare iri ɗaya.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s3.o.a: Siffofin da aka yi amfani da su sun bambanta, saboda haka ƙa'idodin sun bambanta.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s3.r.a: Ko da an musanya siffofin, idan siffofi iri ɗaya suna wurare iri ɗaya, za a iya ɗaukar ƙa'idar a matsayin iri ɗaya. Ka tuna da layukan da ka ƙirƙira a baya.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s3.r.b: Ko da adadin siffofi iri ɗaya ne, ƙa'idodi na iya bambanta. ○ □ ○ □ ○ □ ma yana da siffofi 6.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s3.o.c: Siffa ɗaya tana biye da siffofi biyu iri ɗaya, sannan ana maimaita wannan.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s3.r.d: Kasancewa da siffa ɗaya iri ɗaya kaɗai ba yana nufin ƙa'idodin iri ɗaya ba ne. Ka duba wuraren da siffofi iri ɗaya suke.
n-m-e1-s2b-01.s.s3.explain: A layukan biyun ana maimaita “siffa ɗaya, sai siffofi biyu na wata siffa”. Ƙa'idar ta danganta da wuraren da siffofi iri ɗaya suke, ba da nau'in siffar da aka yi amfani da ita ba.

n-m-e1-s2b-05.title: Fitar da farko, ko saka da farko?
n-m-e1-s2b-05.goal: Koyi cewa idan jerin ƙari da ragi ya canza, labari na iya zama ba zai yiwu ba, sannan ka ƙirƙiri labari da zai yiwu idan aka canza jerin.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.material: Harin tana wasan saka ƙwallaye cikin akwati da cire su. Akwai ƙwallaye 3 a akwatin. Wasan yana da ayyuka biyu: “cire ƙwallaye 5” da “saka ƙwallaye 6”. Ko za a iya yin wasan ya danganta da wane aiki aka fara.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.thinking.0: Ka yi tunanin jerin yadda abubuwa ke faruwa
n-m-e1-s2b-05.thinking.1: Gane yanayin da ba zai yiwu ba (ƙwallaye ba su isa a cire ba)
n-m-e1-s2b-05.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri da kanka labarin da ya cika sharuddan
n-m-e1-s2b-05.prereq.0: Ƙari da ragi da lambobi har zuwa 10
n-m-e1-s2b-05.prereq.1: Karanta labari bisa jerin abubuwan da suka faru
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s1.prompt: Akwai ƙwallaye 3 a akwatin. Za a iya yin wasan nan “a wannan jeri” kuwa? Wasa: cire ƙwallaye 5, sannan saka ƙwallaye 6.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s1.hint.0: Cire ƙwallaye 3 ka yi wasan bisa jerinsa. Da farko duba ko za ka iya yin aikin farko.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kafin yin aiki na biyu, ƙirga ƙwallaye nawa ne a akwatin.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s1.o.a: Ba zai yiwu ba. Akwai ƙwallaye 3 kawai a akwatin, saboda haka ba za a iya fara cire 5 ba.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s1.o.b: Ana iya yi. Ka cire 5 daga 3 sannan ka ƙara 6.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s1.r.b: Ba za ka iya cire ƙwallaye 5 daga akwatin mai ƙwallaye 3 kawai ba. Gwada fitar da ƙwallaye 3 da kanka, sannan ka cire 5.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s1.o.c: Ba za a iya yi ba. Ba za a iya cirewa da sakawa lokaci guda ba.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s1.r.c: Ana iya saka su daban bayan cirewa. Nemo matsalar tana ina.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s1.o.d: Ana iya yi. Akwai ƙwallaye 6 da za a saka, don haka babu matsala.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s1.r.d: Ana saka ƙwallaye bayan an cire. Duba yawan ƙwallayen da ke akwatin a lokacin cirewar.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s1.explain: A lokacin cire ƙwallaye, 3 ne kawai ke akwatin, don haka ba za a iya cire 5 ba. Saka ƙwallaye aikin da zai biyo baya ne, ba ya taimaka.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s2.prompt: Idan muka sauya jerin fa? Akwai ƙwallaye 3 a akwatin. Idan aka fara saka ƙwallaye 6 sannan aka cire 5, ƙwallaye nawa ne za su rage?
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s2.hint.0: Fitar da ƙwallaye 3, sannan bayan saka 6, rubuta yawan ƙwallayen da ke akwatin da farko.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s2.hint.1: Daga wannan adadin, soke yawan da aka cire, sannan ka ƙirga ƙwallayen da suka rage.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s2.r.a: Wannan tunanin ya yi 5−3, ya cire ƙaramin daga babba. Da farko ƙirga ƙwallaye nawa ne a akwatin bayan an saka.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s2.r.b: Ba ka ƙirga ƙwallaye 6 da aka saka ba. Da farko nemo adadin ƙwallaye bayan saka 6.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s2.r.d: Wannan tunanin ya tara 3, 6, da 5 gaba ɗaya. Idan aka cire, ƙwallaye suna raguwa.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s2.explain: Idan aka saka ƙwallaye 6 a tare da 3, ana samun 9; idan aka cire 5 daga 9, 4 ne suka rage. Ko da lambobin iri ɗaya ne kamar 3+6−5, sauya jerin na iya sa wasan ya yiwu.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s3.prompt: Akwai ƙwallaye a a akwatin. Ƙirƙiri yanayi daban-daban guda uku inda ba za a iya yin wasan cire ƙwallaye b sannan a saka c ba, amma idan aka sauya jeri, a fara saka c sannan a cire b, ana iya yi. Bayan kammala jerin da aka sauya, aƙalla ƙwallo 1 ta rage. (a, b, c duk aƙalla 1 kuma ba su wuce 20 ba.)
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s3.hint.0: Tantance adadin ƙwallaye na farko a, sannan zaɓi b, adadin ƙwallayen da ake cirewa, ya fi a girma.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s3.hint.1: Bayan ka tantance adadin ƙwallayen da za a saka c, nemo yawan ƙwallaye idan an fara sakawa da kuma abin da ya rage idan aka cire b daga wannan adadin.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s3.var.b: Adadin ƙwallayen da aka cire b
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s3.var.c: Adadin ƙwallayen da aka saka c
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s3.ok.c1: Lambobin ukun duk aƙalla 1 kuma ba su wuce 20 ba.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s3.fail.c1: Ka sanya a, b, da c duka lambobi daga 1 zuwa 20.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s3.ok.c2: Ana cire ƙwallaye fiye da yawan da ke akwatin tun farko, don haka ba za a iya yin sa ba idan an fara cirewa.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s3.fail.c2: Adadin da aka cire dole ya fi adadin ƙwallaye a akwatin tun farko, don haka aikin “cirewa da farko” ba zai yiwu ba.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s3.ok.c3: Idan aka fara sakawa sannan aka cire, aƙalla ƙwallo 1 za ta rage.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s3.fail.c3: Ko da an fara sakawa, ƙwallayen ba su isa a cire ba ko babu abin da ya rage. Sake ƙirga ƙwallayen bayan sakawa.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s3.explain: Misali, daga akwatin da aka fara da 2 ba za a iya fara cire 4 ba; amma idan aka fara saka 5, sai a samu 7, sannan bayan cire 4, 3 su rage. Zai yiwu idan adadin cirewa ya fi na farko kuma adadin bayan sakawa ya fi adadin cirewa.
